CFML Language Reference: Functions

GetFunctionList

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

Returns a structure with one key for each function the server supports. The values are empty strings; the keys are what you are after.

Category

System functions

Syntax

GetFunctionList()

Returns

A structure keyed by function name.

Usage

Use StructKeyList or StructKeyArray to turn it into a list, or StructKeyExists to check whether a function is available before you call it (useful when code must run on several server versions). The Administrator-only KFUSION_ functions are not included.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Funcs = GetFunctionList()>
<CFSET Names = ListSort(StructKeyList(Funcs), "textnocase")>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>This server knows <B>#StructCount(Funcs)#</B> functions.
<P>Has Hash()? #StructKeyExists(Funcs, "Hash")# &nbsp; Has CFDump()? #StructKeyExists(Funcs, "CFDump")#
<P>The ones whose names start with "Get":
</CFOUTPUT>
<UL>
<CFLOOP LIST="#Names#" INDEX="f">
  <CFIF Left(f, 3) IS "Get"><CFOUTPUT><LI>#f#</CFOUTPUT></CFIF>
</CFLOOP>
</UL>

See also

StructKeyList, StructKeyExists, IsDefined
